# Better Fit Merging

We are now merging fits in the fitting window based on the type of module. Before we were only merging on type with some *limited* merging for the same meta level. Now a given module type is merged together, and the fitting display first shows a summary with a range of stats if the fits differ because of it.

This same range and merged fit is found in the PDF generated, and the EFT is whichever fit is most common.
